sentences.text: The wellbore is 15/9-F-15 (Sodir wellbore 6184) in the Volve field, with status P&A; Sodir records entry on 2007-12-24 and completion on 2008-12-05.
The daily reports run from 2008-11-10, the first report without a before-spud flag, to 2018-01-24, the last report.
The report span is 3363.0 days with 33 active days; of 69 reports, 36 carry a before-spud flag and are excluded from the span, and the reports form 2 campaigns.
Total depth is 4105 m measured depth according to Sodir; the deepest depth in the daily reports is 4090 m measured depth and 3178 m true vertical depth.
Total activity time is 1435.48 h; primary lost time is 74.0 h, which is 5.16% of activity time.
The well was drilled in sections of 36.0 in, 26.0 in, 12.25 in and 8.5 in, with circulation losses in the 8.5 in section and a drillstring separation in the 12.25 in section that was fished.
After total depth the well was plugged back with cement and an EZSV, casing was cut and pulled, and the well was kicked off on 2008-12-11, the last day of campaign 1.
Campaign 1 runs from 2008-11-10 to 2008-12-11, a span of 32.0 days with 32 active days; its dominant operation phase is drilling.
Campaign 2 is a single day on 2018-01-24 with a span of 1.0 day, 1 active day and dominant phase none; its one report carries no activities.
Section 0 (before the first section) holds 0.25 h of moving activity dated 2007-11-18 and reports no hole size.
Section 1 is a 36.0 in hole drilled from 2007-11-19 to 2007-12-22, from 144.2 m to 226.0 m measured depth (226.0 m true vertical depth at section end).
Section 1 drilled 226.0 m of new hole at an average of 18.45 m/h while coded drilling, which is not an on-bottom rate.
Section 2 is a 26.0 in hole drilled from 2007-12-23 to 2007-12-30, from 226.0 m to 1378.0 m measured depth (1347.0 m true vertical depth at section end).
Section 2 drilled 1152.0 m of new hole at an average of 20.57 m/h while coded drilling.

Section 3 is a 26.0 in hole from 2008-09-06 to 2008-09-10 that drilled no new hole, so it stays at 1378.0 m measured depth and 1347.0 m true vertical depth; no drilling rate is reported because no new hole was drilled.
Section 4 is a 26.0 in hole from 2008-09-18 to 2008-09-19, from 1378.0 m to 1381.0 m measured depth (1349.0 m true vertical depth at section end).
Section 4 drilled 3.0 m of new hole at an average of 0.71 m/h while coded drilling.
Section 5 is a 12.25 in hole from 2008-09-20 to 2008-11-12, from 1381.0 m to 2536.0 m measured depth (2350.0 m true vertical depth at section end).
Section 5 drilled 1155.0 m of new hole at an average of 10.11 m/h while coded drilling.
Section 6 is an 8.5 in hole from 2008-11-13 to 2008-11-28, from 2536.0 m to 4090.0 m measured depth (3178.0 m true vertical depth at section end).
Section 6 drilled 1554.0 m of new hole at an average of 8.42 m/h while coded drilling.

Section 7 is the plug-back and abandonment section, from 2008-11-29 to 2018-01-24 at 4090.0 m measured depth and 3178.0 m true vertical depth; its hole size is not reported because the tools give no size, and no drilling rate is reported because it drilled no new hole.

sentences.text: Section 2 starts below the 220.6 m shoe and sets casing with a shoe at 1368.4 m measured depth; the activity record reads: Commenced cementing Lead slurry, 1.52 SG of 20" casing.
Section 3 starts below the 1368.4 m shoe and sets no casing.
Section 4 also starts below the 1368.4 m shoe and sets no casing.
Section 5 starts below the 1368.4 m shoe and sets casing with a shoe at 2561.8 m measured depth according to the tool.
Section 6 starts below a shoe at 2534.0 m, which conflicts with the 2561.8 m shoe given for section 5; the activity record reads: 9 5/8" csg shoe found at 2534 m.
Section 6 sets no casing; section 7 starts below the 2534.0 m shoe and sets none.
Primary lost time is 74.0 h, which is 5.16% of the wellbore's activity time of 1435.48 h.
By section, primary lost time is 1.25 h in section 2, which is 0.7% of that section's activity time, and 4.5 h in section 3, which is 4.48%.
In section 5 primary lost time is 17.5 h, which is 4.05% of that section's activity time.
In section 6 primary lost time is 50.5 h, which is 14.08% of that section's activity time and the largest section share.
In section 7 primary lost time is 0.25 h, which is 0.09% of that section's activity time; sections 1 and 4 have no primary lost time.
By cause, primary lost time is well control (circulation losses) at 49.0 h, and waiting on weather at 13.25 h.
Drilling wait accounts for 5.5 h of primary time, fishing for 4.25 h and repair for 2.0 h.
Possible lost time is reported separately and is not added to the primary figures: 157.0 h in total, which is 10.94% of activity time, with 71.5 h in section 5 and 62.5 h in section 7.
By possible code, interruption -- other is 93.0 h, interruption -- maintain 49.25 h and plug abandon -- wait 14.0 h.
On 2008-09-07 the BOP and riser running stopped for 2.75 h of primary drilling wait while the sea calmed in the splash zone.
On 2008-09-20 the drillstring was found screwed out below a drill pipe pup joint; fishing was coded 4.25 h of primary time in section 5 before the string broke free.
Faults on the ZMS/VICIS drilling control system were coded as possible lost time, for example 6.25 h of circulation while working on the VICIS problem on 2008-09-19.
A main-power blackout on 2008-09-21 cut power to all drilling systems for 0.25 h of possible lost time.
Waiting on weather in section 5 totalled 13.25 h of primary time, including 7.0 h on 2008-11-11 during derrick inspection.
Circulation losses in the Ty formation began on 2008-11-14 with 2.25 h of primary well-control time.

sentences.text: Well control was coded as primary lost time over 23 activities totalling 49.0 h, the activities running into 2008-11-17, and the mud weight was reduced during the losses; the activity record reads: Bled into active to reduce mud weight.
On 2008-11-22 work stopped for 1.0 h of primary wait after the crew left the drill floor because of exhaust fumes, followed by 0.5 h of primary repair to the BX elevator latch.
A rapid trip-tank gain on 2008-11-24 was shut in and the formation judged supercharged; this event carries no lost-time tier.
Total depth of section 6 was reached on 2008-11-28, and a trip-tank gain on the same day was shut in and checked.
Plug-back began on 2008-12-01 with a cement plug.
A second cement plug was pumped on 2008-12-04 and an EZSV was set on 2008-12-05.
The casing was cut on 2008-12-07 and pulled to surface over the following day.
Fault-finding on the pipe-handling PRS on 2008-12-09 took 11.5 h of possible lost time, coded as interruption -- other.
Sodir records completion on 2008-12-05, but the daily reports continue to 2008-12-11 with the drilling-out and kick-off, and a single report on 2018-01-24 is the last, with no activities.
Prepare the loss-control program before the Ty formation is reached: well control logged 49.0 h of primary time in section 6, so the LCM pill and mud-weight plan should be ready before the zone.
Plan riser and derrick work around sea and wind windows: weather waiting cost 13.25 h of primary time in section 5, and the splash-zone wait cost 2.75 h on 2008-09-07.
Function-test the drilling control system and the PRS before each run: possible lost time was 71.5 h in section 5 and 62.5 h in section 7, and it included control-system and PRS faults.
Check make-up of drillstring pup joints and connections: the string was found screwed out and needed 4.25 h of primary fishing time.
Reconcile casing shoe depths against the casing tally before the next section: the tool gives a 2561.8 m shoe for section 5 but a 2534.0 m shoe at the start of section 6.

row.comments: Stabbed 30" conductor in to slot. Broke circulation and confirmed conductor to be full. Closed the 2" vent valve. Ran in with the 30" conductor from 144m to 220.6m
Commenced cementing Lead slurry, 1.52 SG of 20" casing, 1300 lpm 32 bars. Released preloaded ball (1 3/4") for bottom wiper plug.
Waited for sea to calm down to be able to run in with HPDR.
Circulated on well while working on problem with VICIS.

Attempted to work string free. Not able to come down - string at TD. Attempted to come up - functioned jar twice. Attempted to work string free by applying torque up to 40 kNm and overpull of 40 MT. Made way from 1381 m to 1376 m MD. Attempted to pump - hole still packed off. Bled off 27 bar pressure trapped on standpipe and heard loud roarring sound. Lost string weight - went to just above block weight. POOH with 5 1/2" DP and found string screwed out underneath 6 m drilling pup joint. Laid out pup joint - found no damage on threads.
Had black out on mainpower due to incident caused by production. Lost power on all drilling systems.

WOW for derrick inspection. 

Meanwhile changed out bumper bar on aft PRS using parts from fwd PRS. Fixed broken electrical connection on aft PRS. Removed scaffolding from rig floor. Injected slop into F-14. Performed remaining pressure test on kill and choke manifolds. Modified hooks for lifting bridle. Changed o-rings on leaking coomey unit. Installed flush joint elevator on PRS and function tested same.
Drilled out shoe track, 9 5/8" csg shoe found at 2534 m. Parameters: Flow 1700 lpm / SPP 198-210 bar / String RPM 10 / TQ 5-8 kNm. MUD weight 1.44 SG.

Staged up pumps to establish loss free rate. Meanwhile continued adding LCM chemicals to active and prepared 150 kg/m3 LCM pill in pit according contingency plan. Monitored losses while pumping and reciprocating pipe, Flow 440 lpm / SPP 25 bar / String RPM 10 / TQ 9-10 kNm. Average loss rate 1000 ltrs/hr.
Bled into active to reduce mud weight from 1.35 SG to 1.30 SG. Meanwhile rotated and reciprocated pipe from 2670 m to 2641 m , Flow 1000 lpm / SPP 66 bar / String RPM 5 / TQ 5-7 kNm.
Continued staging up pumps in 200 lpm increments from 1000 lpm to 1800 lpm while rotating and reciprocating pipe slowly. Had 0.5 m3/hr losses at 1800 lpm.
Left drill floor due to exhaust (CO levels @ 60 ppm), monitor area until clear reading on sensors.
Changed out BX elevators due to latching problem, back up set would not work, installed original elevator & investigated problem with latch.

Flow checked well, observed rapid increase to Trip Tank, shut in well on upper rams, monitored pressure built up SIDP 0bar (float installed), SICP 6,7 bars.
11:50 bled off approx 1m³ from well and closed in, SICP 5,0 bar - no pressure built up.
12:18 bled off additional 2.75 m³ from well and closed in, SICP 3,2 bars - no pressure built up.
As no pressure built up to original SICP was observed, conclusion is supercharged formation. Continued to bleed off from well, observed decreasing trend in flow back and decided to open BOP. Total volume bled back from well: 4½ m³.
Monitored well on Trip Tank, 9.3m³ gain, shut well in when the flow was at a rate of 8.4m³/hr.
Lined up from cement unit to string. Mixed & pump 9,75 m³ of 1,90 SG slurry @ 800 LPM.
Mixed and pumped 12.04 m³ 1.90 SG G-cement at 800 lpm, 51-23 bars. Displaced cement to rig floor with 892 litres Drill water.

Set EZSV at 1437 m MD by applying 35 righthand rotations / torque 2-4 kNm. Picked up weight and sheared setting sleeve with 26 MT overpull. Picked up 3 m above plug and ran back in to 1437 m MD and tagged plug with 10 MT set down - ok.

Filled pipe pumping at 500 lpm. Obtained pump benchmark for cutting casing 500 lpm / SPP 59 bar, stopped pumps. Started rotation with 120 rpm. Started circulation at 500 lpm. Observer torque bulidingup to 5-11 kNm indicating effective cutting. Noticed small shock in derrick after 2,5 min of cutting indicating successful cut. Stopped rotation. Increased pump rate to 900 lpm / 55 bar - good indication. Picked up 2,5 m above cut. Came down while pumping at 400 lpm, observed sudden pressure drop as prescribed when passing cut at 1422 m MD. Stopped pumping. Marked pipe and tagged top of cut casing 0,25 m below (cut gap).
Troubleshot situation with PRS. PRS not supplying sufficient hydraulic pressure to gripper claw. Performed faultfinding in hydraulic and electrical system.

Drilled cement below 20" shoe and new formation from 1368 m to 1381 m MD. Encountered soft cement underneath shoe. Initiated kick-off. Drilling parameters : 4000 lpm / SPP 190 bar / ECD 1,43-1,44 / 1-2 MT WOB / 60 RPM / Torque 6-10 kNm.

****Operations transferred to F-15****
